goal.title: Play Tetris
goal.description: A broad goal, choosing one button at a time.

button.title: Choose a button
button.description: A specific next-action question. Same state and buttons as the broad goal.

landing.title: Choose a landing
landing.description: Choose a reachable orientation and column; code executes the path.

outcome.title: Choose an outcome
outcome.description: The same placements, with their exact resulting boards shown.

lookahead.title: Choose a two-piece future
lookahead.description: Code searches the next piece for each placement; Jev compares those futures.

greedy.title: One-piece code baseline
greedy.description: A fixed height, holes, roughness and line-clear heuristic.

planner.title: Two-piece code baseline
planner.description: The same heuristic after searching the current and next piece.

result.protocol: Broad goal and button share observations/actions. Landing and outcome share reachable placements. Outcome adds exact one-piece simulation. Two-piece future adds heuristic-guided search. Code baselines use the declared fixed heuristic. Five seeds are exploratory, not a definitive ranking. Replay speed is independent of request latency.
